subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled localhost provider-path evidence sufficient for this FAL private-network and transport-policy change, or must the contributor exercise live FAL or a representative proxy, TLS route, or external private endpoint before merge?
rationale: The patch is correct and follows the canonical contract, but repository policy requires live verification for external API work and the contributor explicitly did not exercise the security-sensitive transport behavior being enabled.

options.title: Require Representative Proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted exact-head output demonstrates live FAL or a representative proxy, TLS, or external private-endpoint route.

options.title: Accept Controlled Proof
options.body: Explicitly waive representative transport proof because the guarded provider-path harness and shared resolver contract adequately cover this narrow change.

recommendation.title: Require Representative Proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted exact-head output demonstrates live FAL or a representative proxy, TLS, or external private-endpoint route.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the FAL shared HTTP/auth helper directly changed by this PR and has substantial adjacent FAL media history.
